trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy. PowerPyx says no multiplayer and no DLC are needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. GTABase: complete the first mission after the Prologue.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. GTABase: completing Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. GTABase: completing Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. GTABase: completing Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. GTABase: completing Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission (Beebom and CULTR word it as Chapter 5). Sources differ on wording.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. GTABase: completing Breakfast Run (Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. GTABase: completing The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. GTABase: completing Child's Play (Chapter 4).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. GTABase: completing Headliners (Chapter 4).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. GTABase: completing VCIA Takedown (Chapter 4).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. GTABase: completing Operation Savage Glory (Chapter 5).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The hardest trophy, per PowerPyx and GTABase. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) and asks for roughly 60% of everything. Nothing on it is missable, and progress made during the story already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. GTABase counts 397 to choose from across 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. GTABase and GamesRadar count 9 types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. GTABase and GamesRadar count 42. All 42 golds are also required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. GTABase and GamesRadar count 14 locations with 42 races total.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twice does not count, GTABase says. The 100% checklist wants 30 wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. PowerPyx and GTABase say his quests start after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. GTABase: this stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. GTABase: this stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. GTABase: this stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger strands. GTABase says some quest lines do not count and the full list of qualifying strands is not confirmed. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete. Yago's race is time-limited in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. GTABase: this stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. GTABase: this stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. The first meditation with Lucia at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1. PowerPyx says this meditation adds 1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot on the map, and that it is gone after Chapter 1. GTABase: counter target 18.
trophies.missable_reason: The first meditation spot is offered with Lucia at Jason's house morning after Down to Earth. It is not marked as a Meditation Spot on the map and disappears once Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as potentially missable. Do it to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. GTABase: which animal is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. GTABase: complete 3 collectible card sets (silver). There are 18 sets total.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. GTABase and GamesRadar count 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 anyway. GTABase: complete 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner. Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, per GTABase. Train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route. Bank vault robberies in Chapter 4 automatically give 4 stars.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable. Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai (Chapter 2+). Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits. Bank vault robbery otomatis memberikan 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level. Available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well. Trophy unlock can lag ~30 seconds after third shop; hit a fourth if needed.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable. Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai (Chapter 3+). Robbery icons respawn. Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning with WAiNK is enough, you do not need to drive them, per GTABase.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. PowerPyx and GTABase say police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Use Adrenaline to extend Focus duration. Gang illegal operations provide plenty of valid targets.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable. Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai. Gang illegal operations tersedia kapan saja. Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away. The E3/E4 departure terminal plane is easiest. Drive through the airfield fence, use stairs beside the boarding bridge to enter, go upstairs to cockpit, reverse to runway, take off. Can also enter via airport terminal on foot.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable (hidden trophy). Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai. Pesawat di VCIA terminals E3/E4 selalu tersedia. Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, the Snap Gun unlocks which opens alarmed back doors silently. Enter through the back, find the note with the safe code, empty the safe, destroy footage and disable alarm without being detected.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable. Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai (Chapter 3+ Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Robbery icons respawn. Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. Your first bank vault robbery in Chapter 4 (That's Where The Money Is...) counts automatically. Earlier, you can block a truck in traffic and blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb (available at Yasmani's shop after his jobs). Escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.missable_reason: Tidak missable. Bisa dilakukan di free roam setelah story selesai (Chapter 4+). Bank vault robbery juga menghitung. Armored truck respawn. Semua konten trophy tersedia pasca-credits.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. GTABase says clear the fog from the whole map. Fastest in a plane, sweeping the blacked-out regions until nothing is hidden.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. GTABase and GamesRadar count 9 gangs. 39 operations total. The 100% checklist requires all 39 operations, so this lands on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing next to the bar. Exact method still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City with the Key Cloner and drive it out through the window. Exact method still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. At the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn (reached through Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling), steal all 3 key valuables (luxury watch, unique shotgun, office safe) and escape. Not missable: the operation respawns if you miss one.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. GTABase: max out Strength for both characters. Work out together at fitness clubs: while you train one character, your partner trains alongside, so both progress at once.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500). GTABase: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; single source.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Steps unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes it involves kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle and labels that belief unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills. A running total, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Needs the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check. Large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while robbing banks for the checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. A running total, per GTABase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. GTABase and GamesRadar count 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

trophies.name: Vice City Legend
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy. (This is the platinum trophy awarded for earning all 54 other trophies.)
